title.en: Get up, look after, give up
title.de: Phrasal Verbs: get up, look after
title.sl: Frazni glagoli: get up, look after
title.it: I phrasal verb: get up, look after

goal.sl: Rabiš vsakdanje frazne glagole (get up, look after, give up) in veš, kateri se razdelijo in kam gre zaimek (turn it off).
goal.de: Du verwendest die alltäglichen Phrasal Verbs (get up, look after, give up) und weißt, welche getrennt werden und wohin das Pronomen kommt (turn it off).
goal.it: Usi i phrasal verb di tutti i giorni (get up, look after, give up) e sai quali si dividono e dove va il pronome (turn it off).
goal.en: You can use the everyday phrasal verbs (get up, look after, give up) and know which ones part and where the pronoun goes (turn it off).

say.sl: **Frazni glagol** je glagol z malo besedo, skupaj pa imata nov pomen: **get up** (vstati), **give up** (odnehati), **look after** (skrbeti za), **look for** (iskati). Pomena ne sestaviš iz delov, zato se ga naučiš kot eno besedo. Spreminja se samo glagol: **Jack got up at five.** **Arthur gave up smoking.**
say.de: **Ein Phrasal Verb** ist ein Verb mit einem kleinen Wort, zusammen mit neuer Bedeutung, wie *aufstehen*: **get up** (aufstehen), **give up** (aufgeben), **look after** (sich kümmern um), **look for** (suchen). Lerne es wie ein Wort. Nur das Verb ändert sich: **Jack got up at five.** **Arthur gave up smoking.**
say.it: **Un phrasal verb** è un verbo con una parolina, e insieme hanno un significato nuovo, come *buttare via*: **get up** (alzarsi), **give up** (rinunciare), **look after** (occuparsi di), **look for** (cercare). Si impara come una parola. Cambia solo il verbo: **Jack got up at five.** **Arthur gave up smoking.**
say.en: **A phrasal verb** is a verb with a small word, and together they have a new meaning: **get up**, **give up**, **look after**, **look for**. Learn it like one word. Only the verb changes: **Jack got up at five.** **Arthur gave up smoking.**

say.sl: Nekateri nimajo predmeta: **sit down, stand up, go out, come back, come in, grow up, set off, break down, hurry up, carry on**. **Come in and sit down.** (Vstopi in sedi.) **We set off at six.** (Odpravili smo se ob šestih.) **The van broke down.** (Kombi se je pokvaril.) **Carry on!** (Kar naprej!)
say.de: Manche haben kein Objekt: **sit down, stand up, go out, come back, come in, grow up, set off, break down, hurry up, carry on**. **Come in and sit down.** (Komm herein und setz dich.) **We set off at six.** (Wir sind um sechs aufgebrochen.) **The van broke down.** (Der Lieferwagen hatte eine Panne.) **Carry on!** (Mach weiter!)
say.it: Alcuni non hanno oggetto: **sit down, stand up, go out, come back, come in, grow up, set off, break down, hurry up, carry on**. **Come in and sit down.** (Entra e siediti.) **We set off at six.** (Siamo partiti alle sei.) **The van broke down.** (Il furgone si è guastato.) **Carry on!** (Continua!)
say.en: Some have no object: **sit down, stand up, go out, come back, come in, grow up, set off, break down, hurry up, carry on**. **Come in and sit down.** **We set off at six.** **The van broke down.** **Carry on!**

say.sl: Nekateri imajo predmet in ostanejo skupaj: **look after, look for, get on, get off, run out of**. **Jack looks after the sheep.** **I'm looking for Meg.** (Iščem Meg.) **Get off the bus at the bridge.** **We've run out of milk.** (Zmanjkalo nam je mleka.) Zaimek pride na konec: **Jack looks after them.** V govoru tudi *get off of the bus*.
say.de: Manche haben ein Objekt und bleiben zusammen: **look after, look for, get on, get off, run out of**. **Jack looks after the sheep.** **I'm looking for Meg.** (Ich suche Meg.) **Get off the bus at the bridge.** **We've run out of milk.** (Uns ist die Milch ausgegangen.) Ein Pronomen kommt ans Ende: **Jack looks after them.** Gesprochen auch *get off of the bus*.
say.it: Alcuni hanno un oggetto e restano uniti: **look after, look for, get on, get off, run out of**. **Jack looks after the sheep.** **I'm looking for Meg.** (Cerco Meg.) **Get off the bus at the bridge.** **We've run out of milk.** (Abbiamo finito il latte.) Un pronome va in fondo: **Jack looks after them.** A voce anche *get off of the bus*.
say.en: Some have an object and stay together: **look after, look for, get on, get off, run out of**. **Jack looks after the sheep.** **I'm looking for Meg.** **Get off the bus at the bridge.** **We've run out of milk.** A pronoun goes at the end: **Jack looks after them.** In talk also *get off of the bus*.

say.sl: Drugi se razdelijo: **turn on, turn off, put on, take off, pick up, throw away, fill in, give back, write down**. Samostalnik stoji na obeh mestih: **Turn off the radio.** = **Turn the radio off.** (Ugasni radio.) **Take off your boots.** = **Take your boots off.** (Sezuj si škornje.) Obe poti sta pravilni.
say.de: Andere werden getrennt: **turn on, turn off, put on, take off, pick up, throw away, fill in, give back, write down**. Das Nomen steht an beiden Stellen: **Turn off the radio.** = **Turn the radio off.** (Mach das Radio aus.) **Take off your boots.** = **Take your boots off.** (Zieh die Stiefel aus.) Beides ist richtig.
say.it: Altri si dividono: **turn on, turn off, put on, take off, pick up, throw away, fill in, give back, write down**. Il nome sta in tutti e due i posti: **Turn off the radio.** = **Turn the radio off.** (Spegni la radio.) **Take off your boots.** = **Take your boots off.** (Togliti gli stivali.) Vanno bene tutti e due.
say.en: Others can part: **turn on, turn off, put on, take off, pick up, throw away, fill in, give back, write down**. A noun can stand in both places: **Turn off the radio.** = **Turn the radio off.** **Take off your boots.** = **Take your boots off.** Both are right.

say.sl: Zaimek stoji pri teh samo v sredi: **Turn it off.** (Ugasni ga, nikoli *Turn off it*.) **Pick them up.** (Poberi jih.) **Put it on.** (Obleci ga.) Samostalnik sme na konec, zaimek ne.
say.de: Ein Pronomen steht bei diesen nur in der Mitte: **Turn it off.** (Mach es aus, nie *Turn off it*.) **Pick them up.** (Heb sie auf.) **Put it on.** (Zieh ihn an.) Das Nomen darf ans Ende, das Pronomen nicht.
say.it: Un pronome sta con questi solo in mezzo: **Turn it off.** (Spegnila, mai *Turn off it*.) **Pick them up.** (Raccoglili.) **Put it on.** (Mettilo.) Il nome può andare in fondo, il pronome no.
say.en: With these a pronoun stands only in between: **Turn it off.** (never *Turn off it*) **Pick them up.** **Put it on.** A noun can go to the end, a pronoun can't.

say.sl: Še nekaj vsakdanjih: **find out** (izvedeti), **look up** (poiskati v knjigi), **put off** (odložiti), **get on with** (razumeti se z), **wash up** (pomivati posodo, britansko), **fill in** (ameriško **fill out**). **Did you find out when the bus comes?** **Poppy looked up the word.** **We put off the dance until May.** **I get on with Jack.**
say.de: Noch ein paar alltägliche: **find out** (herausfinden), **look up** (nachschlagen), **put off** (verschieben), **get on with** (sich verstehen mit), **wash up** (abwaschen, britisch), **fill in** (amerikanisch **fill out**). **Did you find out when the bus comes?** **Poppy looked up the word.** **We put off the dance until May.** **I get on with Jack.**
say.it: Ancora qualcuno di tutti i giorni: **find out** (scoprire), **look up** (cercare in un libro), **put off** (rimandare), **get on with** (andare d'accordo con), **wash up** (lavare i piatti, britannico), **fill in** (americano **fill out**). **Did you find out when the bus comes?** **Poppy looked up the word.** **We put off the dance until May.** **I get on with Jack.**
say.en: A few more for every day: **find out**, **look up** (in a book), **put off** (until later), **get on with** (someone), **wash up** (British, the dishes), **fill in** (American **fill out**). **Did you find out when the bus comes?** **Poppy looked up the word.** **We put off the dance until May.** **I get on with Jack.**

translation.sl: Jack vsak dan vstane ob petih. Z Meg skrbi za ovce. Včasih morata iskati izgubljeno jagnje. Zvečer sede k ognju in si sezuje škornje.
translation.de: Jeden Tag steht Jack um fünf auf. Mit Meg kümmert er sich um die Schafe. Manchmal müssen sie ein verlorenes Lamm suchen. Am Abend setzt er sich ans Feuer und zieht die Stiefel aus.
translation.it: Ogni giorno Jack si alza alle cinque. Con Meg si occupa delle pecore. A volte devono cercare un agnello perduto. La sera si siede vicino al fuoco e si toglie gli stivali.
translation.en: Every day Jack gets up at five. He looks after the sheep with Meg. Sometimes they have to look for a lost lamb. In the evening he sits down by the fire and takes off his boots.

translation.sl: V ponedeljek se je Sam odpravil ob šestih. Pri mostu se mu je kombi pokvaril. Zmanjkalo mu je bencina. V knjigi je poiskal številko delavnice. Potem je izvedel, da je zaprta. Nazadnje je odnehal in šel domov peš.
translation.de: Am Montag ist Sam um sechs aufgebrochen. Bei der Brücke hatte sein Lieferwagen eine Panne. Ihm war das Benzin ausgegangen. Er hat die Nummer der Werkstatt in einem Buch nachgeschlagen. Dann hat er herausgefunden, dass sie geschlossen war. Am Ende hat er aufgegeben und ist zu Fuß heimgegangen.
translation.it: Lunedì Sam è partito alle sei. Vicino al ponte il furgone si è guastato. Aveva finito la benzina. Ha cercato il numero dell'officina in un libro. Poi ha scoperto che era chiusa. Alla fine ha rinunciato ed è tornato a casa a piedi.
translation.en: On Monday Sam set off at six. Near the bridge his van broke down. He had run out of petrol. He looked up the garage's number in a book. Then he found out that it was shut. In the end he gave up and walked home.

exercises.text: Mrs Birkett gets ___ at six and puts ___ her apron. She looks ___ the inn and everyone in it. When the walkers have gone, she picks ___ their cups. Then she sits ___ at last.

translation.sl: Gospa Birkett vstane ob šestih in si nadene predpasnik. Skrbi za gostilno in za vse v njej. Ko pohodniki odidejo, pobere njihove skodelice. Potem končno sede.
translation.de: Mrs Birkett steht um sechs auf und bindet sich die Schürze um. Sie kümmert sich um das Gasthaus und um alle darin. Wenn die Wanderer weg sind, räumt sie ihre Tassen ab. Dann setzt sie sich endlich.
translation.it: Mrs Birkett si alza alle sei e si mette il grembiule. Si occupa della locanda e di tutti quelli che ci sono. Quando gli escursionisti se ne sono andati, raccoglie le loro tazze. Poi finalmente si siede.
translation.en: Mrs Birkett gets up at six and puts on her apron. She looks after the inn and everyone in it. When the walkers have gone, she picks up their cups. Then she sits down at last.
